notes.title: Update 2.0
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone!

I finally finished remaking Lofi Ping Pong from scratch! It took a lot of late nights after work, so I really hope it's actually better now and that all that effort wasn't wasted.
So, patch notes! ːHorseː[/p][p]
[b]Game design[/b][/p][list][*][p]You can miss 3 times before you lose[/p][/*][*][p]You can combine mods (e.g. wind + two balls)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Visuals[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fresh new UI[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Technical[/b][/p][list][*][p]Calibration[/p][/*][*][p]Key rebinding[/p][/*][*][p]5 new languages[/p][list][*][p]Chinese Traditional[/p][/*][*][p]Japanese[/p][/*][*][p]Korean[/p][/*][*][p]Serbian[/p][/*][*][p]Vietnamese[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Autoplay[/p][/*][*][p]Wide screens support[/p][/*][*][p]Steam Cloud[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Content[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added 2 new tracks from Hamiko[/p][/*][*][p]Added “OG” achievement for completing the story without misses[/p][/*][/list][p]Big shout-out to the awesome folks on our [url="https://discord.com/invite/PGcAZCh" style="button" buttoncolor="#8080ff"]Discord[/url] who helped test this version. Thanks to you, it's much more polished than it would have been otherwise.[/p][p]That said, I'm sure there are still bugs lurking around and plenty of room to improve. So please report anything weird you find, and don't be shy about suggesting new features or changes![/p][p]Thanks so much for playing![/p]

notes.title: Lofi Ping Pong will be free soon!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
It's been a while since I posted anything and now I have some news for you.

Lofi Ping Pong and Kovox Pitch will soon become free on Steam! To be more precise, it will happen on the 19th of November 2023.
The main reason for this decision is time (and money). Some people already know that in 2022 I got a job at a gamedev company. There wasn't much time left for my own games, which made it difficult to make updates (I'm not even talking about making a new game). This eventually affected the number of sales, which led me to the decision to make them free-to-play. But that doesn't mean I'm giving them up.

I had an update plan for Kovox Pitch, which I executed this summer and I consider it 100% finished.
Things are more ambiguous with Lofi Ping Pong.
Even though it's already a pretty old game (it's almost 5 years old, sheesh), I want to make two major updates. First of all, I'll make a new UI (I already have all mockups for it). Secondly, I'll make a unified version of the game on all platforms (Steam has the 2019 version of the game made with Gamemaker, Switch and mobiles have the 2020 version made with Unity). Honestly, both updates I want to make primarily for myself, just to see what I've learnt in 5 years. Of course, I'll add stuff like the calibrator too, because it's a rhythm game after all!

In August I was planning to do both updates by the end of this year, but I'm 100% not going to make it in time. I won't be setting any new deadlines, in the last couple of months I haven't done much for one reason - I'm tired. I'll take rest until the end of the 2023, but will keep giggling at your funny reviews on Steam. If you guys are tired too, you're welcome to join the I-Will-Do-It-Later club, it's lovely here.
P.S. Lofi Ping Pong is now free on mobiles too, but the console versions of both games will remain premium. All the best.

notes.title: Lofi Ping Pong on mobiles is out!!!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Finally the game is out on mobile devices! Click on the images to get to the store

[url=https://apps.apple.com/app/id1539408060#?platform=iphone][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34644940/fbd57d4091fb87ca8481ea0d78252d8d4a8f61bd.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.Calvares.LoFiPingPong][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34644940/62b1c1fd9757256088fc1ab6f0e354a75d14237a.png[/img][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34644940/98e2c6694b9d821ac087c40ab18e382e08cd3ea5.png[/img]

[h1]What is and what is not in the game[/h1]

There is:
- free play with a choice of tracks (new ones added)
- story mode (simplified in details)
- completely updated interface (it is more convenient to select tracks, sort by various options)
- more settings (camera movement, turn off the girl's sprite, etc.)
- there are now 4 tries before you lose the game
- you can change the background in the menu c:

No (compared to the Steam version):
- adding your tracks
- track acceleration
- train carriages :c

I do not exclude the possibility that I will add the option to add your own music, I just didn't have an opportunity (time) to do it. I'm interested in doing this myself, so we'll see.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34644940/33a224aa97b9c69849965852b2443f84d377ff2d.png[/img]

[h1]Steam Update[/h1]

Also, if you haven't noticed, I have released an update to the PC version of the game. 
First of all, [b]you can now take screenshots[/b] (sic!). I was wondering why no one wanted to take one screenshot in a year and a half. It turns out that I simply did not add this option to the game, because I thought that Steam would do everything for me!
[b]New tracks[/b] from other artists were also added. Also [b]Portuguese[/b] has been added thanks to Thiago "Thitz" Mania.
The following is a list of bugs that you have written during the year:
- Chinese language is now displayed correctly in the story mode
- buttons X, Y, A, B on the gamepad now work in Triple mode
- the second ball could hit earlier than necessary, now it doesn't
- acceleration settings do not go into the storyline from the free play mode (it was decided to leave the no-fail, not a bug, but a feature)
- the end credits could be cut off, this is fixed
- the animal mask in the plot could remain during the gameplay, now it doesn't

[h1]What's next[/h1]

In the near future, I'm going to fix all the bugs that you find in mobile versions, and add new different things that you want (and which are realizable).
I will try to be online as long as possible. To report a bug or just confess your love to the game - join our Discord channel! Or you can also write about whatever you like here on the game page in the Discussions section.

Join our Discord https://discord.com/invite/PGcAZCh

Until next time!

notes.title: Mobile & Nintendo Switch releases
notes.notes:
Before telling you why mobile release is postponed, yea, [b]Lofi Pong Pong will be on Switch[/b]!!
I'm super excited to announce that and I hope you will love it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34644940/973d1c3d4aa58fbe6ae159961ac1b44bed440d9e.jpg[/img]

Ping pong was already approved for release and now I'm making its' store page. It will be released around December 2020 and should not be delayed, because now the release date is set and it doesn't depend on me.

Now, [b]about mobiles[/b].
Android version of the game has already been done in early September. There are 2 main reasons I didn't release it then.
First of all, I wanted android and ios versions to be released simultaneously, and it turned out that it is quiet hard to get to the App Store. And it's [i]not[/i] about the games' quality (they even didn't see it yet). Apparently, many people like myself can't get to the store for some mystical reason - and I'm trying to do it for several weeks, haha. But there were big improvements in past 4 days and I'm very close to getting to the App Store.
Secondly, Nintendo Switch version was getting a huge chunk of my attention. Switch and mobiles versions seem to be the same, but they are quiet different technically, and sometimes I only worked on the version for Switch.

For now, I can't promise that mobile verisons will be ready in one or two weeks or something like that.
When I will 100% sure that everything is done, I will make a new announcement post, so you girls and boys will know that time has come!

notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

Earlier this spring LFPP came out. I made several patches and one major update (Speed increase). Then I said to everyone and myself that I will stop updating LFPP because I got kinda busy with other stuff.
But [i]Ima hooligan[/i] and wanna break the rules so here you go - an update. Honestly, I just wanted to distract myself a little bit from a new project that I am making now. I am not planning to patch the game (only if this update will have some bugs) and will continue making new game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34644940/a35b02a2bb59b89791db6c487837b7d83fea4782.png[/img]

So, what's new?
New location - attic. It won't appear in Story mode, just in Free play. It has a new gameplay feature - after several hits 3 balls appear on the table, where 2 of them are fake.
Also, 4 new songs are added from our old friends Zmeyev and Satoruu.
You can check new map on the video below.

I hope you like it, it was fun to return to LFPP once again.

notes.title: Patch #3
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Scoring system changes - now you will get more points for faster songs, rather than longer
[*] Fixed the Wind mode (it is more precise now and the ball changes the direction later)
[*] Now 3,2,1 is counted in the song's rhythm
[*] While editing your track you can move the left border not only by 0.05 sec, but by 0.01 sec
[*] You can now see the score in NoFail mode (NOTE: the score from NoFail still won't go to the Leaderboards)
[*] Added Simplified Chinese (thanks to Nyko_Saire). A Traditional Chinese should be added later. Note, that I used different Draw system for Chinese and some things may won't work as intended. If you find such things, please write to the Community Hub or to our Discord server
[/list]

Don't forget that we have a Discord server https://discord.gg/mD6tHDE

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34644940/c917974f98532046c12296c40104676a872228c0.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch #2
notes.notes:

[*] You can delete songs that you've uploaded by pressing Del
[*] You can now play with WASD
[*] If you want to upload a file that's already exists in your playlist, it will upload but the name will be changed to "1/song_name/"
[*] The central stripe on the table is almost transparent now so it will be easier to hit ball when it flies from center to center
